name: Point2
stmt:
structure Point2 where
  x : Int
  y : Int
deriving Repr

name: psub
proof: { x := a.x - b.x, y := a.y - b.y }

name: padd
proof: { x := a.x + b.x, y := a.y + b.y }

name: Collinear
stmt: def Collinear (a b c : Point2) : Prop

name: CollinearOut
stmt: def CollinearOut (a b c : Point2) : Int

name: collinear_preserves
stmt:
theorem collinear_preserves (a b c : Point2) :
    Collinear a b c ↔ CollinearOut a b c = 0

name: cross_translate
stmt:
lemma cross_translate (a b c d : Point2) :
    cross (psub (padd b d) (padd a d)) (psub (padd c d) (padd a d)) =
    cross (psub b a) (psub c a)
proof:
by
  unfold cross psub padd
  ring

name: collinear_translate
stmt:
theorem collinear_translate (a b c d : Point2) :
    Collinear (padd a d) (padd b d) (padd c d) ↔ Collinear a b c

name: cross_cyclic
stmt:
lemma cross_cyclic (a b c : Point2) :
    cross (psub c b) (psub a b) = cross (psub b a) (psub c a)

name: collinear_cyclic
stmt:
theorem collinear_cyclic (a b c : Point2) :
    Collinear b c a ↔ Collinear a b c

name: collinear_swap
stmt:
theorem collinear_swap (a b c : Point2) :
    Collinear a c b ↔ Collinear a b c
proof:
by
  unfold Collinear
                                             
  have hxy : cross (psub c a) (psub b a) = -cross (psub b a) (psub c a) := by
    unfold cross psub
    ring
  rw [hxy]
  exact neg_eq_zero

name: collinear_degenerate
stmt: theorem collinear_degenerate (a c : Point2) : Collinear a a c
proof:
by
  unfold Collinear cross psub
  simp

end Lattice
